{
  "name": "cache-band",
  "version": "0.6.2",
  "description": "A band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, cache fill, hit rate, context fill, auto-compact threshold and a Compact button. 24 languages.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Dr. Christian Teitzel",
    "url": "https://github.com/CTeitzel"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/CTeitzel/claude-code-cache-band",
  "repository": "https://github.com/CTeitzel/claude-code-cache-band",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mods",
    "prompt-cache",
    "context",
    "compact",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the band. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "de",
        "fr",
        "es",
        "it",
        "pt",
        "nl",
        "pl",
        "sv",
        "cs",
        "el",
        "tr",
        "ru",
        "uk",
        "ar",
        "he",
        "hi",
        "th",
        "id",
        "vi",
        "ja",
        "ko",
        "zh",
        "zh-TW"
      ]
    },
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache lifetime",
      "description": "Prompt-cache lifetime for the countdown. auto reads CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, then promptCacheTtl, else 1h (set 5m for an API key without promptCacheTtl).",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "1h",
        "5m"
      ]
    },
    "rtlInTerminal": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Right-to-left in the terminal",
      "description": "Draw Arabic and Hebrew right-to-left in the terminal too. Off: the terminal band is English for them, because many terminals show right-to-left script reversed. The Desktop app always lays them out right-to-left.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
